fluff.overview: Jump grenade launcher platoons equip their jump-capable troops with assault rifles and automatic grenade launchers loaded with inferno rounds. The combination of vertical mobility and incendiary area weapons makes these platoons effective at clearing fortified positions, flushing defenders from cover, and denying terrain with persistent fire. The inferno grenades are particularly dangerous to vehicles and infantry in enclosed spaces, though the arcing trajectories limit precision against moving targets.
